# `sensor_coils`

the coil shapes of the picked channels as a surface manifold (Brainstorm's coil display), with the vertex-to-channel and vertex-to-shape maps.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run sensor_coils --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run sensor_coils --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run sensor_coils --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --channels <channels manifold> --pick <indices selection of it> [--name NAME] [--system auto|ctf|vectorview306] [--details true]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `channels` | manifold points, where {"name": "$channels"} (name the channels manifold (--channels)) | yes |
| `pick` | selection indices, manifold channels.manifold.0, where {"name": "$pick"} (name an indices selection of the channels: which channels get a shape (--pick)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channels` | `--channels` | `required` | - |  | the channels manifold (a points manifold, with its coils) by name |
| `pick` | `--pick` | `required` | - |  | an indices selection of the channels by name |
| `name` | `--name` | `{channels}_coils_surface` | - |  | the surface's name; its maps are <name>_map and <name>_shape |
| `system` | `--system` | `auto` | - | auto, ctf, vectorview306 | how Brainstorm draws the system: ctf (CTF, KIT, 4D, Ricoh), vectorview306 (Neuromag), auto |
| `details` | `--details` | false | - |  | Brainstorm's detailed view: also the reference coils (ctf) and the planar gradiometers (vectorview306) |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`meeg.coil_shapes`](../nodes.md) | channels=channels, pick=pick | system=$system, details=$details | vertices, faces, channel_index, shape_index |
| before | [`geometry.surface_from_parts`](../nodes.md) | vertices=vertices, faces=faces |  | surface |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `surface` | kind manifold, type surface, name $name, derived_from channels.manifold.0 |
| `channel_index` | kind field, kind_name channel map, name {name}_map, on surface |
| `shape_index` | kind field, kind_name coil shape map, name {name}_shape, on surface |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE SENSOR COILS: the coil shapes of the MEG channels as a surface manifold, drawn as Brainstorm draws them (figure_3d PlotCoils): one small quadrilateral patch per coil (the
first four integration points of a CTF / KIT / 4D / Ricoh channel; a Neuromag magnetometer's square scaled as Brainstorm does), each patch two triangles, at the coil's stored
position and orientation. Stored beside the sensor surface: the surface `<name>` and two integer fields on its vertices, `<name>_map` (the channel) and `<name>_shape` (the shape).
A viewer draws the shapes and colours them by `<name>_map`; it builds no mesh. The shape's centre is the channel position nxr uses (nxr::meeg::channelPositions) for CTF-like coils.
What it cannot resolve: a shape is the coil's integration points joined, not its winding; the sizes are what the channel file's points give.

  nxr-neuro run sensor_coils --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --channels <channels manifold> --pick <indices selection of it> [--name NAME] [--system auto|ctf|vectorview306] [--details true]
```
